beats.lane_ledger_head: -- lane ledger: {{used}}/{{total}} owned (branch / base / clean are recorded by lane.claim, since = claim serial, clean = the main agent's clean-tree assertion) --
beats.lane_ledger_head_pool: -- lane ledger[{{pool}}]: {{used}}/{{total}} owned (branch / base / clean are recorded by lane.claim, since = claim serial, clean = the main agent's clean-tree assertion) --
beats.lane_pool_bad_label: a pool label accepts only ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,23}$ (reserved: seq, pools), got `{{pool}}`.
beats.lane_pool_bad_segment: lane.pool usage: 'label|path' — path must be non-empty, without | ; newline, no leading/trailing spaces.
beats.lane_pool_unknown: pool `{{pool}}` is not registered — run lane.pool "{{pool}}|<local checkout path>" first.
beats.lane_pool_path_missing: pool `{{pool}}` has no registered path — run lane.pool "{{pool}}|<local checkout path>" first.
beats.lane_bad_k: a lane number accepts only 1..{{max}}, got `{{k}}`.
beats.lane_claim_usage: lane.claim "lane|req_id|branch|base|clean|pool" (lane 1..{{max}}; pool optional = registered named pool, default pool when omitted; clean must be "1")
beats.lane_claim_dirty: {{lane}} claim refused: `clean` must be "1". The main agent runs `git status --porcelain` in the target worktree first (must be empty except `.lane`); if dirty, pick another lane or handle the changes — the mod cannot run git, it only accepts this assertion.
beats.lane_claim_occupied: {{lane}} is already owned by {{id}} — pick another lane or wait for its release.
beats.lane_claim_bound: {{id}} already holds {{lane}}; a second lane is not allowed.
beats.lane_claim_closed: {{id}} is {{status}} — terminal requirements cannot claim a lane.
beats.lane_claimed: [LANE CLAIMED] {{lane}} ← {{id}} "{{title}}" | branch {{branch}} | base {{base}} | since #{{since}} | clean=1 (the main agent confirmed a clean tree)
beats.lane_release_usage: lane.release "lane|pool" (1..{{max}}; pool optional = registered named pool, default pool when omitted)
beats.probe_rejected: only an empty payload, "0" or "full" is accepted, got `{{got}}`; usage: {{usage}}
beats.worktree_claim_refused: [WORKTREE CLAIM REFUSED] {{lane}}: {{reason}} | the lane ledger was not touched
beats.lane_branch_hint: [HINT] {{lane}} carries no branch: run lane.claim first (payload "lane|req_id|branch|base|clean|pool", branch = feature/xxxx-semantic) so the worktree claim can bind a real branch; dispatching without one only records the ledger.
beats.worktree_release_refused: [WORKTREE RELEASE REFUSED] {{reason}} | the lane ledger was not touched
beats.lane_probe_truncated: [LANE PROBE TRUNCATED] {{call_id}}: the file list was cut at the host output cap - the conflict radar is skipped for this probe
beats.lane_probe_bad_lane: [LANE PROBE REJECTED] lane={{lane}}: out of range 1..{{max}} | nothing was recorded
beats.lane_branch_invalid: [LANE BRANCH INVALID] branch "{{branch}}" violates ^feature/[a-z0-9]{4}-<semantic>$ (total <=48; semantic: lowercase alnum/dash, >=3 consecutive letters, not pure digits, not 8-16 pure hex).
